facts.fact: Olaniwun Ajayi LP says the NIMC Act 2026, signed 26 June 2026, designates NIMC as Nigeria's Root Certificate Authority at the apex of the public key infrastructure, with the technical implications still to become clear in implementation.

NGA.note: Nothing stated on a civil register link.

facts.fact: Olaniwun Ajayi LP says President Tinubu signed the NIMC Act 2026 on 26 June 2026, repealing the NIMC Act 2007.

Olaniwun Ajayi LP says the NIMC Act 2026 makes the National Identification Number the central identifier legally required for passports, voter registration, bank accounts, insurance, tax returns and consumer credit, and creates a General Multipurpose Card.

NGA.note: Root CA role is in the identity act; no electronic transactions or e-commerce law is stated.
No enrolment count or share given.
Nothing stated on a number at birth.

facts.fact: Olaniwun Ajayi LP says the NIMC Act 2026 gives statutory basis to requirements, many already in practice, that registering to vote and filing tax returns need a NIN.

NGA.note: The document describes the law, not the system's issuance, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: Olaniwun Ajayi LP says opening a bank account, buying insurance and applying for consumer credit now legally require a NIN under the NIMC Act 2026.
Olaniwun Ajayi LP says the NIMC Act 2026 makes a NIN legally required across banking, insurance, tax filing, voter registration and passports.
